messages:
From: Ellen Klein <ellen.klein@orchidhealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: security-assessment@orchidhealth.com
Date: Tue, 05 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: onboarding checkpoint package for SOC 2/CAIQ review

Hi Diego,

We are kicking off the controls mapping for our SOC 2 assessor and need a small, curated package showing your entrance/exit and training controls in practice. For scope we need representative artifacts for a subset of employees (both new starters and recent leavers) to validate:

- Background check evidence (redacted PII) including vendor verification statements
- Security & privacy onboarding training completions for role-based cohorts (engineers, product, sales)
- Onboarding checklist + time-to-access (SaaS accounts, Okta join, ticketed access requests)
- Offboarding/deprovision timeline for two recent leavers (timestamps of deactivation)
- A short "checkpoint matrix" that maps artifact -> control objective -> sample file name

Can you provide a curated bundle (redacted PDFs + CSV manifest) by end of week (Oct 8)? Also confirm your acceptable redaction approach: replace name/DOB with employee-id hash and include a vendor attestation where possible. We prefer a secure Drive link or SFTP; please advise transfer method and any DSAR considerations.

Thanks,
Ellen
Ellen Klein
Security & Compliance
Orchid Health
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Klein <ellen.klein@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Oct 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding checkpoint package for SOC 2/CAIQ review

Hi Ellen — thanks for the clear ask. We can deliver a scoped sample bundle that aligns with CAIQ/SIG expectations. Proposed approach: 

1) Produce a checkpoint matrix (CSV) that maps each artifact to the specific control(s) (e.g., HR-1 background check, TD-3 onboarding training).
2) Provide 3 redacted background-check PDFs (vendor-signed) with name/DOB hashed and a short redaction key.
3) Include a training-completions CSV with timestamps and role tags (engineer/product/sales).
4) Supply two offboarding timelines pulled from our IAM logs with exact deactivation timestamps.

We will deliver via a time-limited Google Drive folder (shared link) unless you prefer SFTP. For redaction we use employee-id hashes plus truncated candidate IDs; background vendor attestation will be included where available.

Monica — can you pull the 3 redacted reports and the two offboarding event logs (tickets + IAM entries) and prepare the checkpoint CSV? Marissa / Rishi, tagging you for any privacy/contract concerns on sharing vendor attestations.

Diego
Diego Fernandez
Account Lead, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

If Orchid's assessor needs raw vendor reports for privileged review, we can arrange a controlled viewing with a non-disclosure step — indicate preferred route and we will coordinate.
